annotations.title: List a page's versions and approvals

description: List every version of a page: its number, when it was published, its name, how many comments were left on it, and who approved it or asked for changes on it. Use it when the user asks which version a client signed off, or before restoring an earlier version.

manage_link.description: The private manage link for the page, like https://htmlannotate.com/manage/<page>#k=<key>
